symptom: A Deckle build started sixteen MSBuild worker nodes and could fail with MSB4166 even though Directory.Build.rsp requested one node.
cause: The dotnet CLI appended its default maxCpuCount switch after Directory.Build.rsp was evaluated, so the later command-line value replaced the response-file limit.
violatedInvariant: Every Deckle command-line build uses one low-priority MSBuild node and leaves no reusable MSBuild or Roslyn server.

must: Pass /m:1 explicitly to every dotnet build or publish invocation.
Keep low priority, disabled node reuse, and disabled Roslyn shared compilation in Directory.Build.rsp.
mustNot: Rely on Directory.Build.rsp to override the dotnet CLI maximum node count.

automation.residual: Reliable verification requires observing the live process tree during a real SDK build; static MSBuild property evaluation incorrectly reported one node in the failing configuration.
